craft_notes: Sthāyin: dismissal-joy. Close: impossibility (question). Rejected: 'sin' for kusṛti — killed: evil course kept; 'laughing' for smayamāna — killed: smiling kept.

lines: Regarding his own nature as the presider, he abides as if smiling —
whence, for him, this evil course?
l4.sanskrit_cite: tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ
